name: Chrome DevTools MCP
relevance: Gives coding agents Chrome inspection, debugging and browser automation tools
notes: Requires Node 20.19+ on 20.x, 22.12+ on 22.x, or 23+. Install a supported Chrome/Chrome for Testing browser and configure the MCP client separately. Upstream usage statistics are enabled by default; use --no-usage-statistics when starting the server to opt out. Installation does not start a browser or register the server.

name: Tavily MCP
relevance: Provides web search, extraction, crawling and research tools to agent MCP clients
notes: Upstream recommends Node 20+; use a current Node LTS runtime. Configure a Tavily API key, tool selection and MCP client separately. Search, crawl and research requests can consume account credits; installation does not start the server or send requests.

name: Exa MCP Server
relevance: Provides web and code search plus research tools for agent context
notes: Requires Node 20+. Configure Exa credentials, enabled tools and the MCP client separately. Service-backed search and research requests can consume account credits; installation does not start a server or submit searches.

name: Firecrawl MCP Server
relevance: Exposes website scraping, crawling and browser tools to agent MCP clients
notes: Requires Node 22+. This firecrawl-mcp package is separate from firecrawl-cli. Configure a Firecrawl API key or supported self-hosted endpoint and the MCP client separately. Crawls and browser operations can consume service resources; installation does not start the server or a crawl.

name: Brave Search MCP
relevance: Provides Brave web, image, news and local search tools for agents
notes: Use a current Node LTS runtime; the published commander dependency requires Node 20+. Configure a Brave Search API key, account access and MCP client separately. Installation does not start the server or perform searches.

name: Perplexity MCP
relevance: Connects agents to Perplexity search, reasoning and research tools
notes: Requires Node 18+; use a current Node LTS runtime. Configure a Perplexity API key, enabled tools and MCP client separately. Model and research requests can consume account credits; installation does not start a server or send prompts.

name: Playwright Test CLI
relevance: Runs browser tests and captures traces for coding-agent verification
notes: Requires Node 20+. The @playwright/test distribution supplies playwright and is distinct from playwright-cli and playwright-mcp. Browser downloads, Linux system dependencies and project test configuration are explicit setup steps. Installation does not run tests or install browsers.

name: Hugging Face CLI
relevance: Manages model and dataset artifacts used by agent applications
notes: Requires Python 3.10+. The huggingface-hub distribution supplies hf and also publishes the tiny-agents executable. Configure login and access to gated repositories separately. Model/dataset downloads, uploads and agent/model-provider setup are explicit operations; installation does not download models.

name: GitHub MCP Server
relevance: Connects agents to scoped GitHub repository, issue and pull-request tools
notes: Uses the macOS/Linux Homebrew CLI formula, separate from the hosted remote MCP endpoint. Configure GitHub authentication, token permissions, toolsets, read-only settings and the MCP client explicitly. Enabled tools can modify GitHub resources; installation does not connect or write to repositories.

name: AWS Documentation MCP
relevance: Retrieves and searches AWS documentation for agent infrastructure workflows
notes: Requires Python 3.10+. The official distribution and executable use awslabs.aws-documentation-mcp-server; the catalog package uses its normalized hyphenated name so uv inventory, upgrades and removal match. Choose the documentation region/partition and MCP client configuration separately. This entry is the documentation server, not the other AWS MCP servers.

name: Redis MCP Server
relevance: Provides Redis data and command tools to configured agent MCP clients
notes: The published distribution requires Python 3.10+; follow upstream runtime guidance. Configure the Redis endpoint, authentication, ACLs, enabled commands and MCP client separately. Enabled tools can read or mutate Redis data; installation does not start Redis or connect to a database.

name: Qdrant MCP Server
relevance: Stores and retrieves semantic context for agents using Qdrant collections
notes: Requires Python 3.10+ and a supported native embedding runtime. Configure a Qdrant endpoint or local storage, collection, embedding model and MCP client explicitly. First embedding use can download a model; data ingestion and server startup are separate steps. Native dependency support varies by OS and architecture.

name: MongoDB MCP Server
relevance: Provides database inspection, query and Atlas tools to agent MCP clients
notes: Requires Node 20.19+ on 20.x, 22.13+ on 22.x, or 24+. Configure a MongoDB connection or Atlas account, permissions, read-only/tool settings and MCP client separately. Optional native authentication or local Atlas features may need platform dependencies. Installation does not connect or modify databases.

name: DBHub
relevance: Provides configured multi-database SQL and schema tools to agents
notes: Requires Node 22.5+. Use @bytebase/dbhub, not the unrelated unscoped dbhub package. Configure database drivers, connections, permissions, read-only settings and MCP client explicitly; optional native drivers/SSH can need build tools. Installation does not connect to databases or run SQL.

name: Supabase MCP Server
relevance: Connects agents to scoped Supabase project and database tools
notes: Use a current Node LTS runtime; the published MCP Node dependency requires Node 20+. The canonical upstream repository is supabase/mcp. Configure authentication, project scope, read-only mode, toolsets and MCP client separately. Enabled tools can modify project resources; installation does not create or access projects.

name: Kubernetes MCP Server
relevance: Provides Kubernetes and OpenShift cluster tools for agent workflows
notes: Uses a Node wrapper with native optional packages for macOS/Linux/Windows x64 and arm64. Use a current Node LTS runtime and retain npm optional dependencies. Configure kubeconfig, context, permissions, read-only/tool settings and MCP client explicitly. Enabled tools can modify clusters; installation does not start or connect to a cluster.

name: Terraform MCP Server
relevance: Provides Terraform Registry and HCP Terraform context and tools to agents
notes: Uses the macOS/Linux Homebrew CLI formula. Configure the MCP client, enabled toolsets and any HCP Terraform credentials/permissions separately. Service-backed operations use the selected account scope; installation does not start the server or perform Terraform/HCP operations.

name: Azure MCP Server
relevance: Connects agent MCP clients to configured Azure service tools
notes: Requires Node 22+. The npm wrapper loads native optional packages for macOS/Linux/Windows x64 and arm64; retain optional dependencies and meet upstream OS library requirements. Configure Azure authentication, subscriptions, permissions, toolsets and read-only settings explicitly. Installation does not sign in, provision resources or start the server.

name: Neon MCP Server
relevance: Provides Neon database, branch and project tools for agent workflows
notes: Requires Node 22+. Configure Neon credentials, project scope, permissions, read-only/tool selection and MCP client separately. Enabled tools can create branches, execute queries or modify resources; installation does not access or provision databases.

name: Grafana MCP Server
relevance: Gives agents configured Grafana observability and dashboard tools
notes: Uses the macOS/Linux Homebrew CLI formula. Configure the Grafana URL, service-account token, permissions, datasource/tool selection and MCP client explicitly. Enabled tools can query telemetry or modify dashboards/resources; installation does not connect or start the server.
